Question B-003-014-006.

Why the correct answer is right: Proper speech processing raises useful average speech energy and can make SSB easier to understand in noise.

Per-choice notes:
- sourceIndex 0: "It improves the intelligibility of your signal": This is the correct choice because proper speech processing raises useful average speech energy and can make SSB easier to understand in noise.
- sourceIndex 1: "It reduces average transmitter power requirements": This is a near-miss because it shifts attention from It improves the intelligibility of your signal. In operator controls, keyers, microphones, VOX, speech processing, and receiver noise tools, power alone is not the control or safety mechanism being tested in this item.
- sourceIndex 2: "It reduces unwanted noise pickup from the microphone": This answer would fit a different fault than It improves the intelligibility of your signal. In operator controls, keyers, microphones, VOX, speech processing, and receiver noise tools, noise control may be useful elsewhere, but this choice points to the wrong block or symptom.
- sourceIndex 3: "It improves voice frequency fidelity": This option confuses another station topic with It improves the intelligibility of your signal. In operator controls, keyers, microphones, VOX, speech processing, and receiver noise tools, it names a different cause, control, component, or safety action than the one required here.
